title: credential-circuit-scheduler-and-simple-stream-factory
author: Ethan Kim
description: Summary: Introduces a lightweight credential circuit scheduler and a simple, language-agnostic StreamFactory to unify idiomatic stream construction across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Motivation: Teams repeatedly build small adapters to coordinate credential fallback, heartbeat/ttl alignment, and stream lifecycle hooks. This PR centralizes a small runtime-side scheduler plus SDK-side ergonomic factories so apps get safe defaults without per-language boilerplate. What changed (high level): 1) Core design: credential circuit scheduler that drives reauth backoff windows, cooldowns, and a minimal circuit breaker to avoid thundering reauth storms. The scheduler emits signals (ready, cooldown, eject) consumed by language SDK adapters. 2) SDK ergonomics: StreamFactory added to each SDK to create cancelable, checkpointable streams with consistent hooks (on_start, on_chunk, on_end, on_error) and optional credential binding. 3) Retry profiles: new "latency-aware" and "conservative-auth" presets wired into SDKs; documentation and examples added. 4) Telemetry: lightweight event tags for credential lifecycle events (credential.prefetch, credential.eject, stream.resume) for better sampling in Console. 5) Version bumps: python 1.4.2, typescript 2.8.0, go 1.5.0. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-2642) - [x] Unit tests for scheduler logic - [x] Cross-SDK integration examples - [x] Telemetry tags added - [x] Version bumps and changelogs Updates: Addressed reviewer feedback on cooldown defaults (reduced from 45s to 20s), added defensive nil checks in Go adapter, and constrained the StreamFactory API to a single minimal surface for GA. Backwards compatibility: New default behavior is opt-in via factory.NewStream with backwards-compatible helpers for legacy constructors. Migration notes included in release notes.
commits: a1b2c3d Add credential circuit scheduler core; b4c5d6 Add StreamFactory TypeScript facade; c7d8e9 Add Python adapter and examples; d0e1f2 Add Go adapter and defensive checks; e3f4g5 Add telemetry tags and tests; f6g7h8 Version bumps and changelogs
review_comments: Priya: Please justify the cooldown default; recommend 30s not 45s. Jonas: Why not expose an advanced API for custom backoff? Suggest keeping minimal surface and allow opt-in. Marceline: Go adapter panics on nil callback during drain, please add defensive checks. Author reply: Reduced cooldown to 20s after perf experimentation; advanced API left behind feature flag for now; added nil checks to Go adapter and added unit test to cover drain edge cases. CI history: Initial CI run failed on a flaky test in typescript stream factory (race on mock timer), reran individual pipeline after adding test stabilization, all checks green. Merge notes: Squash merge after final approval from Priya and Jonas. Merge method: squash
release_notes: - Introduce credential circuit scheduler to reduce reauth storms and improve retry behavior. - Add StreamFactory to Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs: consistent cancelable/checkpointable stream primitives. - New retry presets: latency-aware, conservative-auth. - Telemetry: credential lifecycle event tags for Console observability. - SDK version bumps: python 1.4.2, typescript 2.8.0, go 1.5.0
